record.bible_text: Now these <FI>are<Fi> the generations<WH08435> of the sons<WH01121> of Noah<WH05146>, Shem<WH08035>, Ham<WH02526>, and Japheth<WH03315>: and unto them were sons<WH01121> born<WH03205><WTH8735> after<WH0310> the flood<WH03999>.

And Canaan<WH03667> begat<WH03205><WTH8804> Sidon<WH06721> his firstborn<WH01060>, and Heth<WH02845>, <RF>Sidon: Heb. Tzidon<Rf>
And the Jebusite<WH02983>, and the Amorite<WH0567>, and the Girgasite<WH01622>,
And the Hivite<WH02340>, and the Arkite<WH06208>, and the Sinite<WH05513>,
And the Arvadite<WH0721>, and the Zemarite<WH06786>, and the Hamathite<WH02577>: and afterward<WH0310> were the families<WH04940> of the Canaanites<WH03669> spread abroad<WH06327><WTH8738>.

And the border<WH01366> of the Canaanites<WH03669> was from Sidon<WH06721>, as thou comest<WH0935><WTH8800> to Gerar<WH01642>, unto Gaza<WH05804>; as thou goest<WH0935><WTH8800>, unto Sodom<WH05467>, and Gomorrah<WH06017>, and Admah<WH0126>, and Zeboim<WH06636>, even unto Lasha<WH03962>. <RF>Gaza: Heb. Azzah<Rf>
These <FI>are<Fi> the sons<WH01121> of Ham<WH02526>, after their families<WH04940>, after their tongues<WH03956>, in their countries<WH0776>, <FI>and<Fi> in their nations<WH01471>.<CM>

Unto Shem<WH08035> also, the father<WH01> of all the children<WH01121> of Eber<WH05677>, the brother<WH0251> of Japheth<WH03315> the elder<WH01419>, even to him were <FI>children<Fi> born<WH03205><WTH8795>.
The children<WH01121> of Shem<WH08035>; Elam<WH05867>, and Asshur<WH0804>, and Arphaxad<WH0775>, and Lud<WH03865>, and Aram<WH0758>. <RF>Arphaxad: Heb. Arpachshad<Rf>
And the children<WH01121> of Aram<WH0758>; Uz<WH05780>, and Hul<WH02343>, and Gether<WH01666>, and Mash<WH04851>.

And unto Eber<WH05677> were born<WH03205><WTH8795> two<WH08147> sons<WH01121>: the name<WH08034> of one<WH0259> <FI>was<Fi> Peleg<WH06389>; for in his days<WH03117> was the earth<WH0776> divided<WH06385><WTH8738>; and his brother's<WH0251> name<WH08034> <FI>was<Fi> Joktan<WH03355>. <RF>Peleg: that is Division<Rf>

And Hadoram<WH01913>, and Uzal<WH0187>, and Diklah<WH01853>,
And Obal<WH05745>, and Abimael<WH039>, and Sheba<WH07614>,

And their dwelling<WH04186> was from Mesha<WH04852>, as thou goest<WH0935><WTH8800> unto Sephar<WH05611> a mount<WH02022> of the east<WH06924>.
These <FI>are<Fi> the sons<WH01121> of Shem<WH08035>, after their families<WH04940>, after their tongues<WH03956>, in their lands<WH0776>, after their nations<WH01471>.

These <FI>are<Fi> the families<WH04940> of the sons<WH01121> of Noah<WH05146>, after their generations<WH08435>, in their nations<WH01471>: and by these were the nations<WH01471> divided<WH06504><WTH8738> in the earth<WH0776> after<WH0310> the flood<WH03999>.<CM>
